subject: ONE ancient tortoise with a wrinkled neck, round glasses and a domed shell with ONE coin slot cut in its top, never held in one pose
second_characters: ONE vulture banker in a stiff collar a wing away, flinging coins across the lens in EVERY beat; TWO hamster tellers heaving coin sacks at his shoulder

props.big: ONE heap of gold coins as broad as the frame, spilling under his front feet in EVERY beat; from 5.85 ONE tiny pale pine coffin as long as his forearm
props.small: A SWARM of coins and paper scraps tearing past the lens

environment: a bank hall packed top and bottom with coin sacks, safes and queueing old animals, no empty floor
lighting: hard midday daylight, bright and flat, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the tortoise fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, his glasses and wrinkled face never under a quarter of it. He works the coin heap and the camera orbits him on a hard arc, a new shot size every beat, chest-up to very close, never parking. The vulture, the hamsters and loose coins tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat. He throws his whole body into every beat, scooping, slamming, heaving, his shell rocking hard. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: dry creaky old male voice, level
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.20, then the coins carry it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ya kap-LYU na PEN-si-yu TRI-sta LET, ba-YUS shto k VY-kha-du pri-DYOT-sya BRAT kre-DIT na GROB

timeline.line: Я коплю на пенсию триста лет.
timeline.a: chest-up, glasses and coin slot both in frame, he scoops a whole armful of coins off the heap and slams it into the slot in his own shell, the vulture flinging coins across the lens

timeline.line: Боюсь, что к выходу придется брать кредит на гроб.
timeline.a: he heaves the coin heap up and rocks his shell so coins burst out of the slot, a hamster dragging a sack across the lens; at 3.70 he slides his shell sideways sweeping coins back, the vulture slapping a sack onto his shell, the camera swinging to his other side
he hurls a last fistful of coins into the slot and the shell rings
the vulture slaps ONE tiny pine coffin into his front feet and the tortoise whips it flat at the lens
he jams the coffin against his shell slot, too wide to fit, he shoves with his whole body, coins spraying past the lens
the vulture shoves a coin sack into his chest and he knocks it onto the coffin with his shell, coins raking past the lens
he flips the coffin and rocks it like a cradle, coins sliding past the lens
the coin heap collapses under him and a wall of coins hurls past the lens while he hugs the coffin and slams his shell down
he scoops one more armful into his shell slot, the coffin under his arm, and slams his whole body forward

must_appear: 0.00 coins slammed into the slot in his own shell, his glasses in frame; 3.70 his shell sliding sideways, a sack slapped onto it; 5.85 ONE tiny pine coffin slapped into his front feet; 6.55 the coffin jammed against the shell slot and not fitting; 8.65 the coin heap collapsing under him
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a camera riding beside him, a parked camera, a still or empty background, push in, wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, night, dark scene, a hero back to the camera, a hero held in one pose, a prop between his jaws, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.20, English speech, foreign accent, a second tortoise in frame, a second coffin in frame
